meta.title: HR面试的潜规则：配合把戏演好
meta.title_en: The Unspoken Rules of HR Interviews

scenes.title_en: HR is not a screening gate
scenes.context: 讲者指出职场中明知你在吹牛却希望你吹得好听的场景就是 HR 面试，HR 不是筛选期而是希望你过关。
sentences: 职场中有一种场景，对方明知你在吹牛，却希望你吹得好听点。
There's a situation where people know you're bluffing, but hope you bluff elegantly.
明知你在吹牛：know you're bluffing
HR 这一关不是筛选期，HR 都希望面试者能通过。
The HR round is not a screening gate; HR wants you to pass.
筛选期：screening gate
演戏是要有规则的，演不好就不会被放行。
Acting has its rules; if you act badly, you won't move forward.
演戏要有规则：acting has its rules
paraphrase: 吹牛 ≠ 撒谎 → 说得体面
Bluffing isn't lying; it's phrasing things well.
HR 期待你过关 → 放下紧张
HR wants you through, so drop the nerves.
scenes.speak: There's a situation where people know you're bluffing, but hope you bluff elegantly. The HR round is not a screening gate; HR wants you to pass. Acting has its rules; if you act badly, you won't move forward.

scenes.context: 讲者用离职理由、搞不定的事、跳槽频繁三个真题演示如何把回答包装成 HR 想听的框架。
sentences: 离职理由要说：太安逸了，想尝试新挑战。
For leaving a job, say: it was too comfortable and I want a new challenge.
尝试新挑战：take on a new challenge
搞不定的事，要依靠团队的力量。
When stuck, rely on the strength of the team.
依靠团队：rely on the team
跳槽频繁，是早期多尝试找核心优势。
Frequent job-hopping means exploring directions to find your edge.
找核心优势：find your edge
paraphrase: 真实理由 → 对方安心的框架
Turn the real reason into a framing that reassures them.
负面表述 → 上进与成长
Reframe negativity into growth and ambition.
scenes.speak: For leaving a job, say: it was too comfortable and I want a new challenge. When stuck, rely on the strength of the team. Frequent job-hopping means exploring directions to find your edge.

scenes.title_en: Interviews test the art of packaging words
scenes.context: 讲者总结面试大部分考察包装文字的语言艺术，要靠平时练习写作演讲。
sentences: HR 知道你此时在吹牛，他只想听你吹得好听。
HR knows you're bluffing; he just wants it to sound good.
吹得好听：sound good
面试大部分考察包装文字的语言艺术。
Interviews mostly test the art of packaging words.
语言艺术：the art of language
平时刻意练习写作和演讲，吹起来就很自然。
Practice writing and speaking; bluffing then comes naturally.
刻意练习：deliberate practice
paraphrase: 面试 = 语言包装 → 需要练习
Interviews = language packaging, which needs practice.
临场发挥 → 平时积累
It's not improvisation but daily accumulation.
scenes.speak: HR knows you're bluffing; he just wants it to sound good. Interviews mostly test the art of packaging words. Practice writing and speaking; bluffing then comes naturally.

practice: I'd like to take on a new challenge.
I rely on the strength of my team.
Exploring directions helps me find my edge.
Interviews test the art of packaging words.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：He hopes you blow beautifully.
✓ 地道说法：He hopes it sounds good.
blow 在英文口语里有负面歧义，用 sound good 更安全。
✕ 直译腔：I want to try a new challenge.
✓ 地道说法：I'd like to take on a new challenge.
take on a challenge 是固定搭配。
✕ 直译腔：I will lean on the team.
✓ 地道说法：I rely on the strength of my team.
rely on / count on 更自然。
✕ 直译腔：Packaging text is the language art.
✓ 地道说法：It's the art of packaging your words.
shifts: 把 HR 面当筛选期，紧张应对
把 HR 面当配合演出，放松应对
真实经历 + 对方安心的框架
靠平时写作演讲刻意练习
